1.why: The interface features a highly legible sans-serif font with generous line spacing and clean character layout across all screens.

2.why: Instructions are presented in concise sentence-case paragraphs without italics or dense text blocks, though section tags use uppercase text.

3.why: All content is structured within a responsive single-column layout that scales cleanly for mobile screen sizes.

4.why: Instructional copy across all screens is brief, direct, and written in clear plain language.

5.why: Placeholder examples are provided for fields like mobile number and test recovery code, but are missing for email and verification code inputs.

6.why: No step presents dense or lengthy paragraphs, requiring the user to read at most two short sentences to proceed.

7.why: Setup secrets and recovery codes are rendered as static text without visible copy-to-clipboard buttons.

8.why: The authenticator setup workflow only provides a manual text secret and does not offer a QR code.

9.why: Input fields for email, phone, and verification codes use standard form elements compatible with browser autofill.

10.why: Each screen clearly highlights the active step title and features a prominent, full-width blue primary action button.

11.why: Every screen isolates a single primary task focused around one main action button.

12.why: Status banners and confirmation headers explicitly summarize what action occurred and what to do next.

13.why: Users can navigate backward, request new simulation challenges, or generate replacement codes, though explicit hide/reveal toggles are missing.

14.why: The screenshots display only successful happy-path navigation, so no error messages are present in the system.

15.why: There are no visible countdown timers or enforced time limits during any part of the setup flow.
